leftEvidence.title: Jesus breathes and says, “Receive the Holy Spirit”

points.label: Sequence
points.left: The risen Jesus speaks and breathes before his ascension.
points.right: Pentecost follows the ascension and waiting.

points.label: Effects
points.left: Sending and forgiveness accompany the saying.
points.right: Sound, fire-like tongues, filling, and languages accompany the event.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while preserving their setting, sequence, speakers, genre, and stated inference boundary.

rightEvidence.title: All are filled and speak as the Spirit gives ability

payload.tension: The sources narrate Spirit-reception language at different moments and do not explain their temporal relation.
payload.title: Receive the Spirit and be filled at Pentecost
